body:
My note says the farm crew washed their sample jars in this sink. The water turned milky and left a grey film on the pans. By morning the herbs in the window had gone limp and my tongue felt numb.

I left this page where the next person would look.
title: Recipe page, lower corner

body:
They told us to throw away the board but to leave the knife. I said we had served from both, and the man at the door asked only who had signed the delivery.

My helper had signed because I was late. They asked for her address, then said she could go home, and that she was to be left off any list I wrote. We still have the order book. A page is gone.
title: The missing cutting board
